lottery.label: The Shortcut Seeker
lottery.description: You want an immediate exit, a break from your current situation, a shortcut.
lottery.workRelation: Low engagement with long-term work — effort feels pointless if slow.
lottery.riskRelation: Often high but poorly controlled — unconscious risk-taking.
lottery.whatWorks: Strict budgeting if gambling, parallel Plan B with stable income and useful skills.
lottery.trap: Waiting for 'the sign', going into debt, believing opportunity replaces strategy.

comfort.label: Comfort & Zero Stress
comfort.description: You seek tranquility, routine, and psychological security.
comfort.workRelation: You want structure, clear expectations, defined framework.
comfort.whatWorks: Stability, slow but certain progression, automatic savings, predictable job.
comfort.trap: Getting bored, fading out, then exploding after a few years.

builder.label: Patient Builder
builder.description: You want wealth + pride + the feeling of having earned it.
builder.workRelation: Ready to work, but effort must make sense and actually pay off.
builder.whatWorks: Simple business, rare skills, discipline, long-term investing.
builder.trap: Going too complex too early, scattering, inventing sophisticated strategies before having the basics.

safeWealth.label: Safe Wealth Builder
safeWealth.description: You want high income with maximum security.
safeWealth.workRelation: OK with working, but not with putting yourself at risk.
safeWealth.whatWorks: Increase income via rare skills, secure via diversification, insurance, long-term strategy.
safeWealth.trap: Internal contradiction (wanting jackpot without trade-offs) → stagnation.

nomad.label: Global Nomad
nomad.description: You seek geographic freedom and autonomy.
nomad.workRelation: You want to work from anywhere.
nomad.whatWorks: Remote jobs, income in strong currency, understanding of visas, rules, and logistics.

purpose.label: Purpose-Driven
purpose.riskRelation: Often moderate, but emotion can push you to forget yourself.
purpose.whatWorks: Useful jobs + clear limits + anti-burnout system + self-care + protection framework.
purpose.trap: Sacrificing yourself, burning out, confusing value with suffering.

status.label: Status Seeker
status.description: You seek recognition, respect, social identity.
status.riskRelation: Moderate to high depending on ego and competition.
status.whatWorks: Excellence, selectivity, network, storytelling, career strategy.
status.trap: Toxic comparison, performance anxiety, fragile identity if status drops.

recovery.label: Recovery & Rebuilding
recovery.description: You seek security, control, repair, emotional stability, reconstruction.
recovery.workRelation: Need for mastery, sometimes fear of instability.
recovery.riskRelation: Low at first, then increases as security returns.
recovery.whatWorks: Stabilize first (income, framework, routine), then progressive ramp-up, clear plan, realistic goals.
recovery.trap: Judging yourself, trying to catch up 10 years in 6 months, exhausting yourself.
